title: Risk overlay: informational
description: Low-risk, read/produce-only work with no external side effects. See PRD Phase 7, Layer 2.

rules.title: Informational tasks must not mutate state
rules.purpose: Keep the lowest risk tier honest: it should never surprise the user with a side effect.
rules.scope: Tasks whose only risk overlay is 'informational'.
rules.requirement: No filesystem write outside an explicitly requested output location, no network call with side effects, and no message sent on the user's behalf.
rules.evidence_requirement: A review of actions taken shows only reads and the requested output artifact.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 7: risk overlay 'Low-risk informational work'.
